paragraphs: Rhythm Engineering sells In|Sync, an adaptive traffic signal control system that the company says is deployed at more than 3,000 intersections nationwide. The product line also includes CYCLOPS, a vehicle recognition system powered by AI algorithms. A third product, code|GREEN, combines vehicle detection, data collection, timing plan generation, and deployment.

Rhythm Engineering was founded in 2005 by Dr. Reggie Chandra, a traffic engineer who worked in the public sector. In|Sync has since been installed in 31 states and by 140 public agencies. Testimonials on the homepage come from a City Council Member in San Diego, CA and a Principal Traffic Engineer in West des Moines, IA.

quote.text: It is the most-deployed automated traffic signal optimization system in North America.
